## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Prague, Czechia. It starts at Karlovo nám. 1/23.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Invisible Exhibition in Prague will take away your sight, but open up a new world of sensory experiences. During your visit you’ll join a professional guide with visual impairments, who will lead you through the journey.
>
> As you make your way through the Invisible Exhibition, you’ll become more in tune with your other senses. It may not be your usual museum experience, but this loss of sight could open your eyes to how beautiful the world is even with one sense gone. Along the way you’ll hear a talking clock, feel a braille typewriter, and find out about devices used by blind people.
